data.one_liner: Check overlapping DateTime ranges in a list of ranges
data.what_it_does: The package provides a lightweight utility to determine which DateTime ranges overlap. It returns overlapping IDs, the overlapping objects, or a boolean for two ranges.
avoid_when: Complex recurrence rules or non-DateTime intervals
When you need to handle time zones or daylight saving adjustments
strengths: Simple API with no code generation
weaknesses: No support for recurring events or time zone conversions
